name: @koed-labs/desktop
description: Electron control surface for Koed local personal installs.
author: Koed

scripts.build:package: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && pnpm build:preload && vite build
scripts.package:workspace:build: pnpm -w source-runtime:prepare && pnpm --filter @koed-labs/ui build && node ../../scripts/embed-component-manifest-catalog.mjs && pnpm build:package
scripts.package:mac: pnpm package:workspace:build && pnpm package:runtime && rm -rf release/mac release/mac-* && KOED_ADHOC_SIGN_MACOS_APP=true CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false /usr/bin/time -p electron-builder --mac dir && if [ ! -d release/mac ]; then set -- release/mac-*; [ -d "$1" ] && mv "$1" release/mac; fi
scripts.package:linux: pnpm package:workspace:build && pnpm package:runtime && /usr/bin/time -p electron-builder --linux dir
scripts.package:linux:release: node scripts/validate-linux-release-host.mjs && pnpm package:workspace:build && pnpm package:runtime && node scripts/validate-linux-release.mjs .koed-runtime && /usr/bin/time -p electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 && node ../../scripts/desktop-release-checksum.mjs checksum-linux release $npm_package_version
scripts.package:internal:mac: pnpm package:workspace:build && pnpm package:runtime && rm -rf release/mac release/mac-* release/*.dmg release/*.zip release/*.blockmap && KOED_ADHOC_SIGN_MACOS_APP=true CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false /usr/bin/time -p electron-builder --mac dir dmg zip && if [ ! -d release/mac ]; then set -- release/mac-*; [ -d "$1" ] && mv "$1" release/mac; fi
scripts.package:release: pnpm package:workspace:build && pnpm package:runtime && /usr/bin/time -p electron-builder --mac dmg zip -c.mac.sign=./scripts/sign-macos-runtime.mjs
scripts.pretest: pnpm --filter @koed-labs/shared build && pnpm --filter @koed-labs/ui build && pnpm --filter @koed-labs/server build
scripts.test: pnpm test:packaged-smoke && node --test scripts/linux-release.test.mjs scripts/desktop-artifact-report-lib.test.mjs scripts/smoke-packaged-renderer-faults.test.mjs scripts/desktop-bundle-manifest.test.mjs scripts/prepare-macos-signing.test.mjs scripts/verify-macos-package.test.mjs scripts/sign-macos-runtime.test.mjs scripts/packaged-shared-lifecycle.test.mjs scripts/verify-packaged-component-catalog.test.mjs && vitest run --passWithNoTests
scripts.test:browser: pnpm build && pnpm build:validation && electron scripts/validate-project-workspace.mjs && electron scripts/validate-projects-default.mjs && electron scripts/validate-project-transfer.mjs && electron scripts/validate-conversation-cards.mjs && electron scripts/validate-collaboration-interactions.mjs && electron scripts/validate-managed-preview.mjs
scripts.test:browser:v1: vite build --mode v1-validation && electron scripts/validate-v1-ui.mjs && electron scripts/validate-onboarding.mjs && electron scripts/validate-acceleration-lifecycle.mjs
